# Best Waterproof Speakers for the Pool or Beach

**What to look for:**
- **Pool:** Pick one that **floats**, so it survives a knock into the water.
- **Beach:** Pick one with a **dust rating (IP6X)**, which keeps sand out.
- **Care:** Rinse it with fresh water after salt or chlorine exposure. Water ratings don't cover corrosion. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth))

## Top Picks

**1. JBL Charge 6: best all-rounder (about $130–$150)**
- IP68, the highest rating here. It's sealed against both sand and water.
- 20 hours of battery, or 28 with Playtime Boost.
- 40W output, and it can charge your phone.
- What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and BestProducts.com agreed.
- The reviews I found don't say whether it floats.
- Buy: [Walmart / Amazon / Best Buy via What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) · [Amazon / Walmart via BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**2. Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM: best for pool parties with 360° sound**
- IP67 and it floats.
- Sound is even all around, so it works when people are spread out around the pool.
- About 15 hours of battery.
- Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' mid-range pick.
- Buy: [via RTINGS (UE, B&H, Amazon)](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) · [via Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)

**3. JBL Boombox 4: biggest sound and longest battery**
- RTINGS' top waterproof pick.
- Handles long submersion and floats.
- Over 40 hours of battery and very loud.
- Downsides: it's big, pricey, and sounds muffled if you're beside or behind it.
- Buy: [via RTINGS (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart)](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**4. Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4: best budget (about $65–$80)**
- About the size of a softball.
- IP67, floats, and stands up to drops.
- 13–14 hours of battery with 360° sound.
- It has no companion app.
- Buy: [Amazon / Walmart via BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**5. JBL Grip: best light beach-bag speaker (about $100)**
- Can-sized and weighs 0.85 lb.
- IP68 and about 12 hours of battery.
- Good Housekeeping's DJ tester called it his ideal beach speaker.
- The mesh body collects dust.
- Buy: [Amazon / Walmart via Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)

**Also worth a look: soundcore Boom 2 Plus (big party boombox)**
- 100–140W, floats, and about 20 hours of battery (rated with BassUp on and lights off).
- It's IPX7, which means no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach.
- It's heavy at 3.8 kg.
- Price: $249.99 at Soundcore's US store. Dealectric reports that code **AFSC20** took it to $200 when they tested it on Oct 22. The code expires 12/31, and checkout shows the final price.
- Buy: [Soundcore store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission. ([details](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus))

## My Recommendation

- **Most people:** the **JBL Charge 6**, for its sand and water protection, long battery, and fair price.
- **Mainly pool parties:** the **EPICBOOM**, because it floats and plays 360° sound.
- **Tight budget:** the **WONDERBOOM 4**.

Note: I didn't get direct retailer product pages in my search. The links above go to review pages that have "See price" buttons for each store.
